platformOverheadLineItems.label: RHOAI controllers (Dashboard, KServe controller, Model Registry, MLflow)
platformOverheadLineItems.notes: Core operator reconciler loops. Always running regardless of which DataScienceCluster components are enabled.

platformOverheadLineItems.label: OpenShift platform services (ingress, monitoring, logging/Loki, OADP)
platformOverheadLineItems.notes: Cluster-wide platform overhead, not specific to RHOAI, but required on every cluster RHOAI runs on.

platformOverheadLineItems.label: Node Feature Discovery, GPU Operator daemonsets, cert-manager, Connectivity Link, Authorino, Limitador
platformOverheadLineItems.notes: Required whenever any GPU hardware (existing or planned) is present on the cluster.

platformOverheadLineItems.label: AI Gateway / MaaS + Model Registry/MLflow databases
platformOverheadLineItems.notes: Gateway control plane (when MaaS is enabled) plus the backing PostgreSQL instances for Model Registry and/or MLflow.

platformOverheadLineItems.label: AI Pipelines controller (Kubeflow Pipelines + Argo Workflows)
platformOverheadLineItems.notes: Base controller footprint for 1 concurrent pipeline run; add roughly 1 vCPU / 3 GiB per additional concurrent run configured on Step 4.

platformOverheadLineItems.label: Cluster Observability Operator (llm-d dashboards)
platformOverheadLineItems.notes: Recommended for llm-d distributed-inference dashboards; gated on KServe being enabled.

platformOverheadLineItems.label: llm-d inference scheduler + gateway (EPP + inference gateway)
platformOverheadLineItems.notes: Endpoint Picker (EPP) and inference gateway control path for KServe's distributed inference with llm-d.

dscComponents.label: Dashboard
dscComponents.notes: Core web console. Always enabled in practice.

dscComponents.label: Workbenches
dscComponents.capability: Notebook controller (Jupyter/Code Server/RStudio workbench pods are sized on the Workloads step)
dscComponents.notes: RStudio Server workbench image removed at 3.5 for AGPL licensing; self-build recipes exist unsupported.

database.note: PostgreSQL on roadmap, not yet default

dscComponents.label: KServe (Model Serving)
dscComponents.capability: Model serving incl. Distributed Inference with llm-d
dscComponents.statusDetail: llm-d 0.10.0 GA on OpenShift/AKS/CKS; EKS is TP
dscComponents.notes: RawDeployment mode only; Serverless and ModelMesh are removed/retired.

dscComponents.label: AI Gateway / MaaS (Models-as-a-Service)
dscComponents.capability: Model-as-a-Service gateway: metering, API-key auth, rate limiting, usage-based access to served models
dscComponents.notes: Fronts KServe-served models with Red Hat Connectivity Link (Kuadrant: Authorino + Limitador) for auth, rate limiting and usage metering. TP per RHOAI Version Tracker.

dscComponents.label: Kueue
dscComponents.statusDetail: via Red Hat build of Kueue Operator
prerequisites: Red Hat build of Kueue Operator
dscComponents.notes: New at 3.5 GA: boolean flag to self-manage ClusterQueues/LocalQueues (disabled by default).

dscComponents.label: Ray (KubeRay)
dscComponents.statusDetail: Source conflict: release notes say 1.6.x, Supported Configurations matrix lists 1.4.2 (GA x86_64/Arm, TP Power, unavailable Z)
prerequisites: Red Hat build of Kueue Operator

dscComponents.label: Kubeflow Trainer v2
dscComponents.statusDetail: GA on x86_64 and Arm only; unavailable on IBM Power/Z
dscComponents.notes: Training Hub (SFT, OSFT, LoRA, GRPO) can run on Trainer v2 or Ray clusters.

dscComponents.label: Kubeflow Training Operator v1
dscComponents.capability: Legacy training operator (replaced by Trainer v2)
prerequisites: Red Hat build of Kueue Operator
dscComponents.notes: Deprecated since 2.25. EUS exception: supported only through 3.5 Full Support, EOL 27 Mar 2027. Migrate to Trainer v2.

dscComponents.label: Feature Store (Feast)
dscComponents.statusDetail: GA on x86_64/Arm, TP on IBM Power, unavailable on IBM Z
dscComponents.notes: 3.5 adds SparkApplication batch materialization engine and bidirectional workbench visibility.

dscComponents.label: Model Registry

database.note: CORRECTION vs older docs which cited external MySQL as mandatory; a live 3.5 cluster defaults to in-cluster PostgreSQL

dscComponents.notes: 3.4 added OCI-compliant storage layer (ModelCar images). 3.5 EA2 adds Safety/Security Insights tab, cold-start/vRAM metrics.

dscComponents.label: TrustyAI / Guardrails / EvalHub
dscComponents.statusDetail: SOURCE CONFLICT: 3.5 release notes call EvalHub GA with full support; Supported Configurations matrix lists EvalHub 0.3.0 as TP on x86_64 only

database.note: EvalHub local dev mode can run outside Kubernetes

dscComponents.notes: FMS-Guardrails Orchestrator is deprecated (3.5), targeted for removal in 3.6. NeMo Guardrails is the recommended path.

dscComponents.label: MLflow
dscComponents.notes: 3.5: embedded into AI Pipelines, workbenches, Kubeflow SDK/Trainer, AI Hub. Age-based trace archival to S3. EvalCard generation for EvalHub runs.

dscComponents.label: OGX (formerly Llama Stack)
dscComponents.capability: RAG, agentic workflows, vector DB integration
dscComponents.statusDetail: SOURCE CONFLICT: Supported Configurations matrix lists OGX Operator/OGX as GA on x86_64/Arm/Power; the OGX product guide labels the OpenShift AI integration Technology Preview. Individual APIs/providers range GA/TP/DP.

database.type: PostgreSQL (required for production; SQLite dev/test only)

dscComponents.notes: Renamed from Llama Stack at 3.5 EA1 (breaking manual migration). NO Service Mesh operator required on a live 3.5 cluster (correction vs older docs).

dscComponents.label: MCP Lifecycle Operator
dscComponents.notes: Defaults to Removed in DataScienceCluster; must be explicitly set to Managed. mcpCatalog dashboard flag must also be enabled. Roadmap target: GA in 3.6.

perProjectInstances.label: Pipeline server
perProjectInstances.notes: One per project that runs pipelines. API server + persistence agent + database pods.

perProjectInstances.label: MLflow server
perProjectInstances.notes: RHOAI 3.5: training/pipeline runs log to a dedicated MLflow server in the project; needs PostgreSQL + S3.

perProjectInstances.label: OGX server
perProjectInstances.notes: Requests from RHOAI 3.4 Llama Stack docs (secondary source); limits 4 CPU / 12 GiB. Verify.

perProjectInstances.label: PostgreSQL for OGX
perProjectInstances.notes: Production OGX requires PostgreSQL (SQLite is dev/test only).

perProjectInstances.label: Model registry instance
perProjectInstances.notes: Example: one registry shared by 10 projects = 0.1 per project.

perProjectInstances.label: TrustyAI / guardrails per project
perProjectInstances.notes: NeMo Guardrails server + monitoring pods. Guardrail MODELS are sized on the use-case step, not here.

perProjectInstances.label: EvalHub per-tenant instance
perProjectInstances.notes: Optional. Red Hat recommends the shared multi-tenant EvalHub for most organizations.

dependentOperators.label: Red Hat Connectivity Link
dependentOperators.notes: Included in Red Hat AI subscriptions for MaaS use only; confirm entitlement for llm-d-without-MaaS.

dependentOperators.label: Service Mesh 3.x
dependentOperators.notes: Older docs listed this as an OGX prerequisite; a live 3.5 cluster runs OGX with no Service Mesh operator installed.

dependentOperators.label: PostgreSQL Operator
neededWhen: ogx (if OGX PostgreSQL is self-managed rather than external)
